characteristics.name: Summary
characteristics.$text: This Gambit allows the Controlling Player to use Magnus' Willpower Characteristic to gain a positive modifier to the Focus Roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this Model is engaged in a Challenge, the Controlling Player gains a positive modifier to their Focus Roll equal to Magnus the Red's Base Willpower Characteristic minus the Base Willpower Characteristic of the opposing Model in the Challenge.

rules.name: Sire of the Thousand Sons
rules.description:
If a Model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then the Controlling Player may apply the following additional Special Rules to all Auxiliary, Apex and Primary Detachments that have the same Faction Trait as the Model with this Special Rule:
If four or more Troops Battlefield Role Slots in the Primary Detachment of this Army are filled with Units which have a Prosperine Arcana, then all Force Organisation Slots with the Troops Battlefield Role in the Primary Detachment are considered Prime Slots.
Furthermore, if a Model with this Special Rule is part of an Army, then the following Special Rules are granted to all Models with the Thousand Sons Trait in the same Army:
Until the end of the first Battle Turn of the Battle, whenever the Controlling Player of a Model with this Special rule makes a Manifestation Check for a Unit that only includes Models with the Thousand Sons Trait, they may roll three Dice and select any two to determine the result.

rules.name: Arch-Sorcerer
rules.description: A Model with this Special Rule is considered to have the Raptora, Pyrae, Pavoni, Corvidae and Athanaean Prosperine Arcana (see page 220).

rules.name: Arch-Magister of the Corvidae
rules.description: A Model with this Special Rule has the Corvidae Prosperine Arcana and the Thaumaturgy and Divination Psychic Disciplines.

rules.name: Magister of Dust
rules.description: A model with this Special Rule has the Telepathy and Divination Psychic Disciplines.

rules.name: Conduit
rules.description:
When a Model that has a Weapon with this Special Rule manifests a Psychic Weapon:
If that Psychic Weapon is a Ranged Weapon, modify the Ranged Strength Characteristic of that Psychic Weapon by +1.
If that Psychic Weapon is a Melee Weapon, modify the Strength Modifier Characteristic of that Psychic Weapon by +1.

characteristics.name: Summary
characteristics.$text: This Psychic Power grants paired Achea force swords the Precision (5+) Special Rule.

characteristics.name: Trigger
characteristics.$text: The Active Player may choose to Manifest the Mindsong of Blades Psychic Power in the Assault Phase, at the start of the Declare Weapons and Set Initiative Steps Step of a Combat that includes a Unit with at least one Model with the Khenetai Trait.

characteristics.name: Focus
characteristics.$text: The Focus of the Power must be a Model with the Khenetai Trait that is part of a Unit that is in the Combat.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: The Target Unit must be the Unit that the Focus is part of.

characteristics.name: Duration
characteristics.$text: If successfully Manifested, the effects of this Psychic Power last until the end of the Fight Sub-Phase being resolved.

characteristics.name: Process
characteristics.$text:
1. Once the Focus and Target Unit have been decided, the Controlling Player of the Focus must make a Manifestation Check,
2. If the Manifestation Check is successful, then all paired Achea force swords that Models in the Targe Unit have gain the Precision (5+) Special Rule.
3. If the Manifestation Check fails then there is no further effect.

characteristics.name: Summary
characteristics.$text: This Psychic Reaction allows the Unit to gain an Invulnerable Save against Volley and Melee Attacks.

characteristics.name: Trigger
characteristics.$text: The Reactive Player may choose to declare a Bladeweaving Psychic Reaction in the Assault Phase, at the start of Step 4 of the Charge Process, if the Active Player declares a Charge targeting a Unit that includes at least one Model with the Khenetai Trait.

characteristics.name: Cost
characteristics.$text: The Reactive Player must spend 1 point of their Reaction Allotment to declare a Bladeweaving Psychic Reaction. This cost is paid if the Willpower Check is successful. If the Willpower Check fails, the cost is not paid.

characteristics.name: Focus
characteristics.$text: The Focus of this Psychic Reaction must be a Model with the Khenetai Trait under the Reactive Player's control, and must be a part of the Unit targeted by the Charge that triggered this Psychic Reaction.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: The Target Unit must be the Unit that is the target of the Charge that triggered the Reaction.

characteristics.name: Duration
characteristics.$text: If successfully Manifested, the effects of this Psychic Reaction last until the end of the Fight Sub-Phase in which it was declared.

characteristics.name: Process
characteristics.$text:
1. Once the Focus and Target Unit have been decided, the Controlling Player of the Focus must make a Manifestation Check.
2. If the Manifestation Check is successful, then all Models in the Unit that is the target of the Blessing gain a 5+ Invulnerable Saving Throw against any wounds inflicted.
3. If the Manifestation further Check fails then there is no effect.

rules.name: Warriors of the Khenetai
rules.description:
A Unit that includes Models with this Special Rule cannot have a Prosperine Arcana selected for it. Instead, they have the Khenetai Prosperine Arcana. This follows all the Rules for Prosperine Arcana as described on page220.
All Models in a Unit with the Khenetai Prosperine Arcana gains the following benefits:
The Bladeweaving Psychic Reaction
The Mindsong of Blades Psychic Power
The 'Khenetai' Trait

rules.description:
Castellax-Achea can have wounds suffered as a result of Perils of the Warp applied to them instead.


If a Model with the Thousand Sons Trait suffers Perils of the Warp while within 6" of a friendly Model with this Special Rule, the Controlling Player can apply the result from the Perils of the Warp table or any wounds suffered if
the Psychic Power was from a Prosperine Arcana to a Model in this Unit instead. If a Model with this Special Rule suffers the ÆthericFeedback result, it instead suffers one wound which ignores all Saving Throws and Damage Mitigation Rolls.

characteristics.name: Summary
characteristics.$text: This Psychic Power improves the effectiveness of Ranged Attacks made by the Unit.

characteristics.name: Trigger
characteristics.$text: The Active Player may choose to Manifest the Ætheric Guidance Psychic Power in the Shooting Phase, at the start of Step 4 of any Shooting Attack made by a Unit that includes at least one Model with the Unattuned Trait controlled by the Active Player.

characteristics.name: Focus
characteristics.$text: The Focus of the Power must be a Model with the Unattuned Trait that is part of the Unit making the Shooting Attack.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: The Target Unit must be the Unit that the Focus is part of, and must only include Models with the Thousand Sons Trait.

characteristics.name: Duration
characteristics.$text: If successfully Manifested, the effects of this Psychic Power last until the end of the Shooting Attack being resolved.

characteristics.name: Process
characteristics.$text:
1. Once the Focus and Target Unit have been decided, the Controlling Player of the Focus must make a Manifestation Check. 
2. If the Manifestation Check is successful, then all ranged Weapons Models in the Target Unit have (excluding Weapons with the Blast (X) Special Rule) gain the Breaching (6+) Special Rule. 
3. If the Manifestation Check fails then there is no further effect.

characteristics.name: Summary
characteristics.$text: When this Gambit is selected, the Controlling Player may use their Model's Willpower Characteristic instead of the result of the Focus Roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: If this Gambit is selected, then immediately after the Controlling Player has made their Focus Roll in the Focus Step, they may choose to replace the result of their Focus Roll (after modifiers) with this Model's Willpower Characteristic.

characteristics.name: Summary
characteristics.$text: This Reaction gives the Reacting Unit an additional Save Test against attacks that Target the Reacting Unit.

characteristics.name: Trigger
characteristics.$text: Once per Battle, the Reactive Player may declare the Fortress of the Mind Advanced Reaction during Step 4 of the Shooting Attack process of any Shooting Attack declared by the Active Player that targets a Unit whichonly includes Models with the Thousand Sons Trait and does not contain any Models with the Vehicle Type.

characteristics.name: Cost
characteristics.$text: The Reactive Player must spend 1 point of their Reaction Allotment to declare a Fortress of the Mind Advanced Reaction, this cost paid as soon as the declaration is made.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: The Target Unit is always the Unit whose Shooting Attack triggered the Reaction. The Reacting Unit is always the Unit that was declared the target of the Shooting Attack that triggered this Reaction.

characteristics.name: Process
characteristics.$text:
1. Once a Fortress of the Mind Advanced Reaction has been declared, the Reactive Player must make a Willpower Check for the Reacting Unit.
2. If the Willpower check is passed, the Reacting Unit gains a 3+ Invulnerable Save against all wounds inflicted as part of the Shooting Attack that triggered the Reaction.
3. If the Willpower Check is failed, the Reacting Unit gains a 5+ Invulnerable Save against all wounds inflicted as part of the Shooting Attack that triggered the Reaction. Additionally, both the Reacting Unit and the Target Unit suffer the Warp Rupture result from the Perils of the Warp table, resolved immediately after Step 11 of the Shooting Attack.
